title: rubus koehleri var. casparyi
intro: Rubus koehleri var. casparyi, commonly known as Caspary's thimbleberry or Western thimbleberry, is a variety of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rubus koehleri var. casparyi include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to be effective in soothing and protecting the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
